mostWorthwhile.text: Placing the traction panels was most worthwhile: the explanation of rails spreading wheel loads made the solution physically understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: The winch placement was confusing because it said the crossing was already supported beneath the wheels before I had built the crossing.

surprise.text: The winch description implied support was already in place, even though the panels came later.

arbitrary.text: Anchoring the winch before laying the panels felt unclear in purpose at first, though its role in controlling the crossing became clear later.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the farther ice core reveals, although this chapter's mostly forced sequence offered few meaningful decisions.
